claim: On a Blood enemy the XSprite key field is what it drops when it dies (key k drops item kItemKeyBase + k - 1), not a lock.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/actor.cpp:3053-3054 (actKillDude: if pXSprite->key > 0 actDropObject(pSprite, kItemKeyBase + pXSprite->key - 1)); also actor.cpp:2567-2568 (actInit, a dude removed for the game mode drops its key)
use: To have a key carried by a monster, set the monster's key field; a reader must not read it as a locked thing.
